{{Quote|You want to explain to me why you're illegally jacked into our computer system?|The Kloperian mechanic confronts R2-D2|<ref name="TNR ">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>}}
This '''Kloperian mechanic''' was part of a group of 50 [[Kloperian]]s working on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to upgrade the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|starfighters]]. The Kloperians were installing [[Bomb/Legends|detonators]] in the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] on behalf of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]]. This [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] found [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] jacked into a [[computer terminal]] where the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was not authorized to be. The Kloperian took the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and its counterpart, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], into the hangar bay where the Kloperians were working and locked them into a closet. The droids were later released.<ref name="TNR " />
